metadata.annotation_policy: first geometric surface according to annotation_glass; unrefracted rays; geometric interpolated view normals; camera z-depth by default; no per-pixel instance IDs

camera_qualification.physical_time: time_seconds = normalized playback progress * explicitly configured duration_seconds; null when unassigned; motion clips are retimed to this timeline
camera_qualification.placement_denominator: all 13x9 source proxy rays, including misses; at five normalized trajectory parameters; not measured for RGB-only captures without overlap_mixture
camera_qualification.rendered_denominator: valid source pixels; exact production same-time first-surface membership, including glass

scene_family.rule: group all frames, cameras and appearance/sensor variants of a generator-version/seed family before assigning dataset splits

camera_qualification.selection: requested strata are fixed before placement retries; no rendered or model-score filtering
camera_qualification.triangulation: mean angle of shared rendered world positions on a regular grid of at most 4096 source pixels/view; null when position was not exported or no shared samples

exposure.scope: all capture cameras; RGB only; geometry annotations unchanged

exterior_background.depth: metric distance to finite proxy geometry; not physical astronomical sky distance

flow.axes: positive x right, positive y down
flow.direction: forward; source timestep t to target t+1, same camera index
flow.optical_flow_units: pixels per captured interval; not pixels per second
flow.precision: float32 raster attachments; no color conversion or tonemapping
flow.surface: first geometric surface including opaque glass; excludes reflection/refraction and shading motion
flow.terminal: last timestep has zero vectors and both masks zero
flow.valid: source surface retains vertex correspondence and target lies between near/far planes; off-screen targets remain valid
flow.visible: valid target lies in image and passes target surface depth test
